note: The standard gloss already carries the sense: "care (looking after; also departure)" covers «Его́ ухо́д был неожи́данным» / "His departure was unexpected".
«Доро́га прохо́дит че́рез не́сколько уча́стков» needs "section", which the standard's own note ("a section of land; a sector or district") already reaches.
Every sentence uses the plain "institution" sense; the flag is about го́род being rendered "town", which is a sentence matter, not a gloss one.
«Врач наде́л бе́лый хала́т» / "a white coat" is exactly the sense the standard's note already names — "robe (a dressing gown or lab coat)".
"Loud bangs could be heard" for «гро́мкие хлопки́» is covered by the standard note "a sudden sharp sound, a bang".
Both flagged senses — "owners of the farm" and "waited for its master" — are already spelled out in the standard note "(an owner; a master; a landlord)".
"All the ladies of the house" sits inside "hostess (a female host; a housewife or landlady)" plus the existing alt "housewife"; the flag itself asks for a sentence fix, not a gloss one.
«Учи́тель похвали́л шко́льника» / "praised the pupil" is already accepted through the existing alt "pupil".
«Он изуча́ет эконо́мику в университе́те» / "studies economics" is already accepted through the existing alt "economics".

«Ру́сский язы́к о́чень бога́тый» and «Она́ хорошо́ владе́ет языко́м» both need "language", a sense absent from the standard ("the part in the mouth") and from the only alt, "reading"; no other corpus word is glossed "language".
"There are many potholes in the road" for «мно́го ям» is reached by the existing alt "hole" — a pothole is a hole in the road — so no new sense is missing.
The heart and wave sentences need "beat", which the standard already names: "to fight (to struggle; to beat)".
«Зимо́й быва́ют си́льные моро́зы» / "there are severe frosts" is the existential sense, which the existing alt "to happen" already reaches.
«снег не вали́л бы так гу́сто» / "the snow would not pour down" is covered by the standard note "to pour in crowds" and the existing alt "to pour".
«Она́ владе́ет тремя́ языка́ми» / "has a command of three languages" is the skill sense already carried by the note "(to possess; to master a skill)" and the alt "to master".
The three «вступи́ть в» sentences rendered "join" are already accepted through the existing alt "to join".
Every sentence is plain strolling or walking, both covered by the standard and the alt "to walk"; the flag asks for a sentence retranslation, not a wider gloss.
«Э́то де́лается о́чень про́сто» and «Таки́е ве́щи де́лаются осторо́жно» need the passive "is done", which the standard note "(to happen or be made)" and the alt "to be made" already reach.
Both senses in play are already covered by the standard "to guess" and the alt "to suspect"; the flag concerns which of them the sentence should use.
"Come to an arrangement" is the standard's own note and "to arrange" is an existing alt, so nothing the sentences need is missing.

"Admitted him to the exam" is the existing alt "to admit", and «допусти́ть оши́бку» is reached by "to allow" — the corpus itself renders «не допусти́л бы тако́й оши́бки» as "would not allow a mistake like that", so a collocational "to make" alt would only loosen grading.

Three of the four flagged sentences (dog, friends) are the "also to acquire" sense already in the standard, and «Она́ заведёт буди́льник на семь» is the same start-it-going sense as starting an engine, so no alt is genuinely missing.

alt: to ask (only of putting a question, задава́ть вопро́с)
note: Five of the seven sentences are «задава́ть вопро́сы» rendered "ask" — «Учи́тель задаёт мно́го вопро́сов» / "The teacher asks many questions" — and neither "to assign" nor the alt "to set" accepts that; the note keeps it apart from спра́шивать "to ask (to put a question)".
«я не занима́л бы де́нег у друзе́й» / "would not borrow money" is already accepted through the existing alt "to borrow money".
The four "earn" sentences are already accepted through the existing alt "to earn".
Every sentence is straightforward fastening; the flag is about the tap-hint gloss of «замо́к», a different headword, not about застегну́ть.

alt: to take along (to bring something with you)
note: «Ты захва́тишь ключи́ с собо́й?» / "Will you take the keys with you?" plus the two umbrella sentences need the grab-and-bring sense, which neither "to seize (to capture by force)" nor the alt "to capture" covers.

alt: to set (of the sun going down)
note: «Со́лнце захо́дит за́ горы» / "The sun is setting behind the mountains" needs the sunset sense, which neither "to drop in (to enter or visit)" nor the alt "to enter" covers.
Every sentence is plain excusing or forgiving, both already covered by the standard "to excuse" and the existing alt "to forgive"; the flag asks which the sentence should use, not for a wider gloss.
«Иногда́ на́ши жела́ния исполня́ются» / "come true" is the "to be fulfilled" sense the standard already states outright.
All four flagged sentences are the trial sense, already accepted through the existing alt "to test" (and named in the standard note).
Both flagged sentences are the trial sense, already accepted through the existing alt "to test".

«Он коло́л оре́хи но́жиком» / "cracking nuts" is the split-with-a-blow sense already carried by the note "to chop wood" and the alt "to chop"; a separate "to crack" alt would add no sense the sentences need.
Both soup sentences need "to stir", which the standard note and the existing alt "to stir" already provide.
«Зима́ наступа́ет ра́но» is the temporal sense the standard note names ("to arrive — of seasons or events") and the alt "to come" accepts.
«Ско́ро насту́пит весна́» and «Ско́ро насту́пит но́вый год» are covered by the standard note "to arrive — of time" and the existing alt "to arrive".
«Она́ всегда́ но́сит с собо́й зо́нтик» / "carries an umbrella with her" is already accepted through the existing alt "to carry".
Both «Ремо́нт обошёлся до́рого» sentences use the cost sense, already in the standard note and the existing alt "to cost".
«Ты бы обраща́лась с ним мя́гче» needs "to treat", which is both in the standard note and an existing alt.
The three birthday/anniversary sentences need "to celebrate", already in the standard note and in the existing alt "to celebrate".
